summary: QuasarEdge Acquisition Corp (QRED), a SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting entry into a definitive merger agreement with Robseek Intelligence Inc. to effect a business combination. The transaction involves a SPAC merger and acquisition merger, with QRED merging into its wholly owned Purchaser subsidiary, followed by Merger Sub merging into Robseek. Existing QRED ordinary shares and rights will convert into Purchaser equivalents. No deal price, premium, or valuation is disclosed. Shareholder vote and regulatory reviews are pending. Watch for shareholder redemption risk and SEC review of the proxy statement.
